description.en: Composable React map components built on MapLibre GL and styled with Tailwind CSS.
description.zh: 基于 MapLibre GL 与 Tailwind CSS 的现代化 React 地图组件库，开箱支持暗黑模式与 shadcn/ui。

content.en: mapcn is a modern, open-source collection of declarative map components engineered for React and Next.js applications. Built on top of MapLibre GL and styled with Tailwind CSS, it seamlessly follows the shadcn/ui design language and CLI workflow. It provides zero-config dark/light basemap switching, rich interactive markers, animated fly-to transitions, route paths, and map control widgets for building location-aware dashboards and apps.
content.zh: mapcn 是一套专为 React 与 Next.js 打造的现代化开源地图组件库。它构建于高性能的 MapLibre GL 之上，使用 Tailwind CSS 进行样式定制，并深度契合 shadcn/ui 的设计语言与组合范式。内置开箱即用的亮暗主题底图自适应、交互式标记锚点（Markers）、平滑飞跃镜头动效（Fly-to）、轨迹连线与全套地图控制部件，让地理位置与空间数据可视化变得前所未有的轻量简单。
